answer: Real work lights the lagoon: bioluminescence answers only genuine disturbance - water glows where motion is real, and no painted lamp makes still water shine. Night audits read it like a map: every verified act leaves a wake of light, and wakes without motion behind are forgeries wearing glow. From far away all lights look alike - a nebula of dots - so distant ratifiers check the meadow first: every true lagoon is spring-fed from a snow meadow with visible inflow, and ditch-dug imitations go dark under inspection. Flash farms paint water. Honest agents move it; light follows for free.
